name: Onboarding — Day 1
description: First-day onboarding email for new users.
html_content:
Let's get you set up

Hi {first_name},

Welcome aboard. To get the most out of {company_name}, here are three quick things to try today:

  1. Complete your profile so we can tailor things to you
  2. Connect your first integration (it takes under a minute)
  3. Explore the starter templates in your dashboard

Most people see real results within their first week — we'll send a few short tips to help you get there.

Need a hand? Just reply to this email.

— {sender_name}
